name: Cable Stability Ball Russian Twist
steps: Rest your shoulders on a stability ball beside a chest-height pulley with your feet wide and the handle in both hands above your chest.
Turn your chest away from the pulley and roll onto the back of your far shoulder as your hands travel with your torso.
Guide your shoulders back across the ball.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your arms long and your hips lifted.
Brace your core and roll smoothly across your upper back without dropping your hips.
